integrity: Adjacency is derived directly from residue classes modulo the maximal ideal. Twin classes prove the forcing lower bound, and explicit force sequences prove every two-fiber complement forces. Rank-two and rank-three symmetric bilinear witnesses are explicit; the even-order rank-two obstruction is proved from isotropic-line geometry together with the local-ring inequality |m|>=q. The polynomial-to-parameter inversion is exact algebra.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to finite commutative local rings that are not fields.
The zero forcing polynomial recovers the residue-field order and maximal-ideal size, not the local ring isomorphism type.
The characteristic-two polynomial branch is already covered graph-theoretically by the known complete-multipartite zero forcing polynomial formula.
The real minimum-rank statement uses real symmetric graph-pattern matrices.
title: Zero forcing polynomials and a rank transition in finite local unit graphs
